newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended lower, pressured by declines in German Bunds.
Traders said volume was thin, with selling concentrated in Federal 2006, 2007 and 2008 maturities.
One trader reported a large sell order, but also said that buying emerged at the lows.

The Swiss market continued to hold up relatively well compared with Bunds. The Swiss franc also strengenthened against the German mark on Tuesday, although both fell versus the dollar. Migros Bank, the financing arm of the Swiss retail chain, set a 150 million Swiss franc bond maturing August 2003.
The Migros bond was quoted on one dealer's screen Tuesday afternoon yielding 3.19 percent.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 down 25 at 113.10*
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 down six at 98.37.
